scope.method: Read-only project inventory, UTF-8 text credential pattern scan, JSON parse checks, PNG/JPG decoding, generated/derived image SHA256 to adjacent record checks, and visual review of all eight unique user screenshots. No system credentials were read and no Git state was changed.
scope.limitations: Pattern scan is not proof that no unknown secret exists. Files may change because production workers are still closing their handoffs; rerun against final staged file set before pushing.

imageProvenance.mainStyleReferences: Two copied project references are separately identified by records/style-reference-manifest.json, with original historical model/quality unknown preserved.
imageProvenance.generationEvidenceLimitations: Root UI 18-24 and map/FX v2 have disclosed recovery gaps. Valid sidecars and file hashes do not prove exact model/quality or missing original tool responses.

thirdPartySources.visualPrivacyReview: All eight unique screenshots were viewed. They show game tutorial, tactics, character and map UI. No visible email, telephone, real-name account information, chat conversations or credential field was observed.
